_comment: Token amounts are TOKENS, not dollars. Presale price = hard_cap_sol / presale tokens. Terms are fixed in SOL; USD is display-only.

A_as_given.description: Founder's allocation exactly as stated. Presale ASSUMED to be the unlisted 5M remainder (20+20+25+25+5 = 95M). UNCONFIRMED.

B_recommended.description: Rebalanced: presale 25M self-funds the LP above presale price; insiders 35% instead of 50%. Raise sized to a ~900-member community.

B_conservative.description: Same allocation as B, smaller raise in case demand is thin.

C_ecosystem.description: RECOMMENDED for the LBG ecosystem plan: B plus deeper LP (17M, ~89% of net raise), presale contributor vesting, slower insider unlocks. Insiders 33%.

emissions._comment: Monthly release plan for C_ecosystem. Month 0 = listing day. Community releases are CEILINGS gated by the health rules in docs/ECOSYSTEM_PLAN.md; unspent budget rolls forward (supply is fixed, nothing is minted).
